scene: You step off the glowing walkway into the bustling Starlight Convenience Arcade.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a neon arcade floor. On the far left sits the end of the flat moving walkway. Beside it stands the Korean teenage boy with silver hair, mint-green hoodie, headphones, and dance bag. Left is a glowing pink claw machine; centre is an automated noodle stand; right stands a drinks machine.
